members.name: routing_A
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific request or problem is the customer describing?

criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card / is the card ready to use
criteria.card_arrival: Card ordered but not arrived yet, tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery to a country or on a specific date
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring, renewing or replacing an expiring card
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order/get a physical card, card availability abroad, what getting a card costs (fees for the standard or physical card itself)
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card, cards for family members
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card or disposable virtual card, what they are, limits on disposable cards
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Choosing Visa or Mastercard, which card brand you get
criteria.card_linking: Linking/adding a card to the app, making a card show up in the app, reactivating or re-adding a card that was lost and then found again
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which businesses take the card
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card can be used at, ATM support
criteria.card_not_working: Card stopped working in general, virtual card not working, contactless not working
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment in a shop or online was declined/refused
criteria.change_pin: Changing or setting the card PIN, where to change the PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: Card PIN is blocked / locked after wrong PIN attempts
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay (Google Play): setting it up, or topping up / adding money via Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.card_limits: Daily spending limit on the card
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment the customer does not recognise or did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise
criteria.compromised_card: Card may be compromised, someone else used the card, suspicious activity, freeze the account
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, reporting a stolen card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere (not with the customer), using or protecting the app without the phone
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or need to reset the app passcode, can't log in with passcode
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for one purchase
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase, cancel a purchase or order to get money back, dispute a merchant transaction
criteria.refund_not_showing: Refund from a merchant not showing up yet
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: ATM dispensed less cash than requested / wrong amount of cash received
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted or cancelled by the bank/app/merchant, came back or was returned to the account; customer asks why
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge or fee on the statement that the customer cannot tie to any transaction or known fee type
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment still pending / not gone through yet
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still pending or not showing
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM withdrawal declined / could not get cash
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into my account from another bank
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money, getting salary paid in
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending, how long until it goes through
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.transfer_not_received: Transfer sent but recipient has not received it
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: Bank transfer into the account not showing in balance
criteria.failed_or_declined_transfer: A transfer failed or was declined for a general reason (not because of the particular beneficiary)
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer to a particular beneficiary / payee is not allowed or was blocked because of who the beneficiary is, beneficiary restrictions
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel or undo a transfer or transaction they made, fix a transfer sent to the wrong account
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque, which top-up methods are accepted (NOT Apple Pay / Google Pay, which is its own option)
criteria.top_up_problem: Top-up pending, failed, declined, reverted/returned, or money from top-up missing
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code or why a top-up must be verified
criteria.deposit_not_showing: Cash or cheque deposit not showing in the balance
criteria.card_payment_fee: Fee charged when making a payment or transaction with the card, e.g. a purchase that went through but carried a fee (not the cost of getting a card)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: Fee charged for ATM / cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee: Fee charged for a transfer, including the recipient receiving less than the amount sent
criteria.top_up_fee: Fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, how rates are set
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment or cash withdrawal abroad
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies are supported for holding and exchanging, salary in another currency
criteria.verify_identity: What documents are needed to verify identity, how to verify
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failing, app can't recognise me
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank supports / can I use the account abroad
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/Amex) the customer can use to add money, which currencies are supported
